apis.description:
Get the discovery page configuration for the domain root account.

Returns labels exactly as stored, with no HTML-escaping applied.
Callers are responsible for escaping on render (the admin React UI
does this via JSX auto-escaping).

apis.description:
Update or create the discovery page configuration for the domain root account.
This is a full replacement - provide the complete configuration including
primary, secondary, and active fields. Any fields omitted will be removed.

operations.notes:

parameters.name: discovery_page[primary][authentication_provider_id]
parameters.description: The ID of an active authentication provider for this account.

parameters.name: discovery_page[primary][label]
parameters.description: The display label for this authentication provider button.

parameters.name: discovery_page[primary][icon]
parameters.description: Icon key for this authentication provider button.

parameters.name: discovery_page[secondary][authentication_provider_id]
parameters.description: The ID of an active authentication provider for this account.

parameters.name: discovery_page[secondary][label]
parameters.description: The display label for this authentication provider button.

parameters.name: discovery_page[secondary][icon]
parameters.description: Icon key for this authentication provider button.

parameters.name: discovery_page[active]
parameters.description: Whether the discovery page is enabled. Defaults to false if not provided.

apis.description:
Returns a short-lived RS256-signed JWT containing the discovery page
button link configuration, suitable for sending to the identity service
preview iframe via postMessage.

A discovery_page configuration must be provided in the request body.
Omitting it returns a 400 Bad Request.
